title: Lesson 39 - Reporting on Unified Data: Report Types, DMOs, and What to Configure First
description: View and build reports and dashboards using Data 360, focusing on where Data 360 data appears in reports, the report types exposed, and what a consultant must configure first.

questions.question: A consultant must report on a customer together with the source records that unified into that customer. Which approach is correct?
options: Build a standard report on the Unified Individual data model object only
Create a custom report type using the unified object as the primary object and relating the source object and the unified link object
Report on the raw data lake object
Copy the source records into a CRM custom object first
questions.explanation: The unified link object joins a unified profile to its contributing source records, which requires a custom report type relating the unified object, the source object, and the link object. A standard report reads a single object and cannot show the related source records.

questions.question: Which statement about standard versus custom Data 360 reports is TRUE?
options: A standard report can join up to four related data model objects
A custom report type can join up to four related data model objects, while a standard report reads a single object
Both report kinds write their output back to the data model objects
A standard report can only be built on a calculated insight
questions.explanation: A custom report type joins multiple related data model objects, up to four, using the lookup relationships, while a standard report is built on one object. Reports read data and present it; they never write back to the objects.

questions.question: A user with the correct license and the connector permission set cannot find a Data 360 object in the report builder. What is the most likely cause?
options: The object has no page layout
The user lacks access to the underlying data model object, so it is not available to report on
Data 360 reports cannot use unified objects
Bucket columns must be created before the object appears
questions.explanation: Report availability follows the sharing model of the underlying object, so a user who cannot see the data model object cannot report on it. Page layouts, unified object support, and bucket columns are unrelated to object availability in the builder.
